description: Defines the IEventHandler interface with pure virtual methods for handling container events such as start, stop, failure, and state changes, within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface declaring event handling methods for OCI container events within the plugin namespace.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container has started.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container has stopped.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container has failed.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container's state has changed.
